notes: Legacy WP posts live in src/data/content.json (live site source of truth). Keep src/content/blog/*.md exported via npm run export:blog-md so Payload Import is never empty. Jenkins sync --clean → restore-blog-md-from-git → merge-payload-blog merges CMS posts into content.json. The Cloudflare account is configured on the Tenant in Payload, not in wrangler.toml. Never add custom-domain routes to wrangler.toml.
